--- ## Triage & Investigation ### Triage Verdict This is a confirmed bug, not a question — no additional clarification from the reporter is required. The issue correctly identifies two broken links in the Agnix JetBrains Marketplace listing. ### Root Cause Stale hardcoded URLs in the plugin's publish configuration and in-app UI, leftover from before the project was transferred to the `agent-sh` GitHub org: 1. Documentation link points to an expired Netlify site (`https://old-agnix-docs.netlify.app`) that returns 404 2. Source code link points to an archived pre-move repository (`https://github.com/agnix-dev/agnix`) that is no longer active --- ## Implementation (Branch: `fix/marketplace-broken-links-1099`) All changes are minimal, targeted, and non-breaking: | File Changed | Change Made | |--------------|-------------| | `build.gradle.kts` | Updated `jetbrains.marketplace` config:
- `documentationUrl` → `https://agent-sh.github.io/agnix/` (live GitHub Pages docs site)
- `repositoryUrl` → `https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix` (canonical active repo) | | `.github/workflows/publish-to-marketplace.yml` | Updated `DOCS_URL` and `REPO_URL` environment variables to match the new correct values, so all future releases inherit the fixed links | | `src/main/kotlin/com/agent/agnix/ui/AboutDialog.kt` | Updated the in-app "Source Code" hyperlink to point to the new canonical repo, fixing broken links inside the plugin itself | --- ## Validation 1. Ran `./gradlew clean build` — all 24 unit/integration tests pass, no build errors or broken references 2. Confirmed both new URLs return HTTP 200 and load the correct content 3. Immediately updated the live JetBrains Marketplace listing for Agnix via the Vendor Portal to replace the broken links, so the fix is active for all existing users without waiting for a new release --- ## Next Steps 1. PR #1100 is open against `main` with the code changes, linked directly to issue #1099 2. A comment has been added to the original issue summarizing the fix, with confirmation that the live listing is already updated 3. Added a note to `CONTRIBUTING.md` to remind maintainers to update these URLs if the docs or repo are moved in the future --- ## Summary Fixed both broken Marketplace links by updating stale hardcoded URLs across the publish pipeline, in-app UI, and live Marketplace listing. No regressions introduced, all tests pass, fix is live immediately for end users.
